description: This file defines a client-side API for managing notes without authentication, using localStorage for persistence. It includes functions for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, summarizing, and importing notes from files, along with internal helpers for storage and summarization.

methods.name: getNotesFromStorage
methods.description: Retrieves notes array from localStorage, parsing JSON data.

methods.name: saveNotesToStorage
methods.description: Saves notes array to localStorage as JSON string.

methods.name: generateLocalSummary
methods.description: Creates a simple summary of note content, using first sentences or characters.
